tasks.subject: Task 1: CsCallout data model and ids
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsCallout.js
- Modify: tests/js_unit.js (CORE_FILES + test block)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] CsCallout.KEY names every XDATA key as a constant; no later task hard-codes a tag string
- [ ] CsCallout.STYLES maps all six style names to a layer name
- [ ] CsCallout.nextId([...]) returns max+1 as a string, and "1" for an empty list
- [ ] nextId ignores non-numeric junk rather than throwing
- [ ] File loads under node with no QCAD symbols referenced at load time

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js && ./tests/run_all.sh -> ### UNIT OK <n> assertions

tasks.subject: Task 2: CsCallout.reflow leader geometry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Given a text box and N tip points, produce the polyline vertices for every branch. The heart of the feature and the only reason a callout stays glued.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsCallout.js
- Modify: tests/js_unit.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] reflow(box, tips, opts) returns {side, landing:{x,y}, branches:[[{x,y}...]]}
- [ ] Side chosen by mean tip x vs box center x on "auto"; obeyed when pinned
- [ ] Landing attaches at the VERTICAL MIDDLE of the box's near side, not the baseline
- [ ] Each branch is exactly three points: tip, elbow, landing end
- [ ] Landing length falls back to a text-height multiple when dimasz/dimscale absent
- [ ] Zero tips returns zero branches without throwing
- [ ] A tip inside the text box still produces a valid three-point branch

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js && ./tests/run_all.sh -> ### UNIT OK <n> assertions

**Steps:**
- Write the failing geometry tests (left/right/pinned/multi/fallback/degenerate)
- Run node tests/js_unit.js, expect FAIL: reflow is not a function
- Implement CsCallout.reflow with the vertical-middle docblock rationale
- Run both runners
- Commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsCallout.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "node tests/js_unit.js && ./tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["auto side both ways", "pinned side wins", "landing at vertical middle", "three-point branches", "text-height fallback", "zero tips safe", "tip inside box safe"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: CalloutWrite document layer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One place that turns pure reflow output into entities and operations, so there is exactly one definition of what a callout looks like in a document.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/CaveSurvey/Callout/CalloutWrite.js
- Create: tests/callout_write.js
- Modify: tests/run_all.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] existingIds(doc) returns every CalloutId in the drawing
- [ ] members(doc, id) returns {text: entity|null, leaders: []}
- [ ] create(doc, di, spec) adds a tagged text plus one tagged leader per tip, on the style's layer, and returns the new id
- [ ] applyReflow(doc, di, id, group) rewrites leaders and passes group to setTransactionGroup
- [ ] Entity ids are learned by DIFFING the id set, never ids[ids.length-1]
- [ ] dimVar(doc, handle) passes a NUMERIC default and maps 0 to null
- [ ] textHeight and suffixFor live here, not on any one command
- [ ] Two grouped reflows collapse into ONE undo, asserted

**Verify:** ./tests/run_all.sh -> ### CALLOUT-WRITE OK

**Steps:**
- Write tests/callout_write.js (CaveCAD-engine only, cannot run under node)
- Run it, expect FAIL: cannot open CalloutWrite.js
- Implement CalloutWrite: existingIds, members, boxOf, create, idSet, newIds, writeLeaders, applyReflow, dimVar, textHeight, suffixFor, unlink
- Register the test section in tests/run_all.sh
- Run ./tests/run_all.sh
- Commit

tasks.subject: Task 7: CsElevation floor sampling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The pure answer to 'what is the floor elevation at this point', from LRUD D and down-splays, with an honest fallback and no fabricated zeros.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsElevation.js
- Modify: tests/js_unit.js
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js (enforced by test_every_core_file_is_included_by_csall)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] floorWalkable(entry) returns the SHALLOWEST of a multi-value D, 0 for P, null when absent
- [ ] sampleFloor(survey, resolved, point, opts) returns {z, basis, from, to, fraction, multi} or null
- [ ] Returns null when no leg is within tolerance
- [ ] basis 'floor' interpolates between the two bracketing evidence points
- [ ] basis 'line' returns the survey-line z when no floor evidence exists, NEVER 0
- [ ] A down-splay between the stations lowers the answer
- [ ] A splay with no inclination on record is IGNORED (CsTraverse.offset null guard), not treated as flat
- [ ] multi is true when the governing station's D had extra readings
- [ ] The divergence from CsProfile (shallowest vs deepest) is pinned by test AND docblocked

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js && ./tests/run_all.sh -> ### UNIT OK <n> assertions

**Steps:**
- Write the failing floorWalkable tests including the CsProfile divergence pin
- Write the failing sampleFloor tests on the three-station A1/A2/A3 fixture
- Implement sampleFloor, nearestLeg, floorEvidence, interpolate in full
- Add CsElevation.js to CORE_FILES after CsProfile.js and CsCallout.js
- Run both runners
- Commit

- [ ] elevLabel(null, ...) returns null, never a fabricated string

tasks.subject: Task 9: CalloutListener live glue
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Edits made with QCAD's own tools keep the callout together, inside the user's own undo step. Delivers the user's actual requirement, last, on a proven reflow core.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/CaveSurvey/Callout/CalloutListener.js
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/CaveSurvey.js (install at startup)
- Modify: tests/callout_write.js (mixed-group undo assertion)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Installed once at startup; a second install does not stack a second listener
- [ ] Editing a callout's text reflows its leaders, and ONE undo reverts both (checklist row 2)
- [ ] Moving a callout's text reflows its leaders; the tips stay put (rows 3-4)
- [ ] Deleting the text deletes the orphaned leaders (row 6)
- [ ] Deleting the LAST leader leaves the text as ordinary text with callout tags stripped (row 7)
- [ ] A transaction touching nothing with a CalloutId returns without querying the spatial index (row 8, counter-verified)
- [ ] The handler never retains the document argument; closing a drawing does not crash (row 9)
- [ ] All ten rows of the Step 5 checklist pass, results recorded

**Verify:** Hand-verified in CaveCAD against the Pitfall Cave fixture per the Step 5 ten-row checklist, plus ./tests/run_all.sh -> ### CALLOUT-WRITE OK for the mixed-group undo assertion. Rows 2, 4 and 9 are must-pass: no unit test covers them.

**Steps:**
- Write CalloutListener.js with the busy re-entrancy guard and the cheap XDATA gate
- Install it from CaveSurvey.js init() with an includeBasePath-relative include
- Add the mixed-group undo assertion (foreign op + reflow, same group, one undo)
- Verify the cheap gate with a temporary counter over fifty unrelated lines, then remove it
- Walk the ten-row hand-verification checklist and record every result
- Commit with the checklist results in the message

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Callout/CalloutListener.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/CaveSurvey.js", "tests/callout_write.js"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["row 1: text edit reflows leaders", "row 2: ONE undo reverts text edit AND reflow", "row 3: text move reflows, tips stay put", "row 4: ONE undo reverts the move and its reflow", "row 5: tip grip drag re-points only that arrow", "row 6: deleting text deletes orphaned leaders", "row 7: deleting last leader leaves text as plain text", "row 8: fifty unrelated lines pass the gate zero times", "row 9: closing a drawing with a second open does not crash", "row 10: cscsync afterwards reports the right count, nothing refused"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "gateScope": "all ten checklist rows; 2, 4 and 9 are must-pass", "failurePolicy": "STOP and report on any of rows 2, 4, 9", "modelTier": "standard"}
```
